title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join a small, high-ownership engineering team building systems that process large volumes of enterprise data using reliable workflows and AI/LLM capabilities. You'll work across backend, frontend, data processing and cloud infrastructure, with significant ownership from design to production.


Responsibilities:

  • Build APIs and backend services using TypeScript/NestJS.
  • Develop durable, long-running workflows using Temporal.
  • Build interfaces using React + Vite.
  • Work with Python for data processing and AI workflows.
  • Process large datasets using Polars, DuckDB and Parquet.
  • Work with PostgreSQL, Redis and Azure.
  • Build reliable tests and troubleshoot complex production issues.
  • Contribute to architecture and engineering decisions in a fast-moving environment.


Requirements:

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience with production-shipped work.
  • Strong TypeScript and good working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience with backend/API development.
  • Good SQL and understanding of real-world data.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in an ambiguous, startup-like environment.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.
  • Tech Stack: TypeScript, NestJS, Temporal Python, React Vite, Polars DuckDB, Parquet, PostgreSQL, Redis, Azure, Docker, Terraform, LangGraph.


Good to Have:

  • Temporal / Airflow / Step Functions.
  • React / Vite.
  • Polars / DuckDB / Arrow / Parquet.
  • LLM/AI applications.
  • Docker / Terraform / CI/CD.
  • Azure / LangGraph
